expected: Confirmation email in the inbox (or spam) within minutes; provider message id visible
actual: NO email of any kind from founders.click reached Gmail after 42 minutes (three separate sends to two aliases: 2 confirmations + 1 ticket receipt). Gmail received unrelated mail normally in the same window (LinkedIn 05:54Z). Same inbox shows ZERO founders.click messages in the last 60 days including the welcome email for the founder's own workspace. The Outlook account derekcbowen@outlook.com is likewise still unconfirmed 23h after its confirmation resend (08:38Z 09-01). The hook returns 200 even when EmailIt fails, by design, so the signup UI reports success.
customer_impact: Every new customer is told to check their email and nothing arrives. No account can be activated through the product. Password reset and support-ticket receipts are on the same path.
